scope: static canonical lower-limb template with bounded spine diagnostics
classification_rule: Only explicitly listed research-derived quantities have a cited origin. All remaining parameters in listed source modules are authored. Cited origin is not model validation.

parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: No age, subject mass, measured body composition or patient calibration is supplied.
The height interval is a software range. Osteological sex selects a shape template.

parameters.supported_population: Repository coefficients cite the American White adult lines of Trotter and Gleser (1952). This historical source population does not establish applicability to a caller.
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Original coefficient tables and calibration extrema were not independently re-extracted.
Inverting stature-on-bone regression does not calibrate bone-on-stature prediction.
The tibial regression omits the medial malleolus; the authored solid adds it.

symbols: all remaining long-bone dimensions and shell/end-region rules
units: degree or radian as declared in source
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Shape ratios and landmarks are not a cited osteometric table.
Edits do not rebuild stored landmarks.
Foot bones have an authored shell and no medullary canal.

parameters.supported_population: Shepherd and Seedhom (1999) studied 11 sets of cadaveric human ankle, knee and hip joints.
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: These are template choices, not subject measurements.
Stature scaling and female adjustments are authored.
No cartilage-specific density region exists in this integral.

parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: No measured cross-section or muscle-volume data set calibrates these shapes.
Static geometry does not establish contact or load-bearing behavior.

parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Convex-hull lofts and the smooth ankle union are not measured tissue boundaries.
Canonical-to-visual/rig/bake mapping remains separate #297.
The hip cut excludes proximal envelope above it.

parameters.supported_population: Research across anatomical sites and health states, summarized by Morgan, Unnikrishnan and Hussein (2018); no one calibrated template population.
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Literature ranges are context, not a validated software interval.
Porosity is applied once; separate pore-fluid/marrow mass is not added.
Elastic metadata is unused by the integral and is not a constitutive law.

parameters.supported_population: Mendez and Keys (1960), mammalian skeletal muscle. Human subject applicability is not established here.
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Mendez J, Keys A. Density and composition of mammalian muscle. Metabolism. 1960;9:184-188. The original experimental table was not re-extracted.
No age, site, composition or temperature uncertainty is propagated.

parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: The marrow-fat assignment is a documented template assumption, not a validated real marrow density.
Cartilage, menisci, ligaments, vessels, lymphatics and nerves have no separate assignment; any higher-priority tissue wins, otherwise fat is used.
Water fraction is not applied again to wet density.

parameters.supported_population: de Leva (1996) adjusted segment parameters from young adult research samples. Those data are context, not a matched validation set for this template.
parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: No matched subjects, measurement uncertainties or task-specific acceptance thresholds are supplied.

parameters.software_range: See the source guards. These are software limits, not empirical calibration limits.
unknowns: Finite fantasy expressions remain allowed; finite input does not establish anatomical compatibility.
Endplane consistency is not load-bearing validation.
SweepField.volume sums overlaps and does not subtract cuts. It must not be added as a disjoint body-tissue total.

intentional_overlap_allowlist.scope: Primitives inside one named bone, muscle or sweep field
intentional_overlap_allowlist.does_not_allow: Overlaps between distinct named bones or between a bone and a disc

intentional_overlap_allowlist.scope: Skin envelope and its internal assignment regions
intentional_overlap_allowlist.reason: The envelope is the domain, not a second mass contribution.

intentional_overlap_allowlist.scope: Leg and foot envelopes at the ankle
intentional_overlap_allowlist.reason: A smooth union is sampled once.

intentional_overlap_allowlist.scope: A body endplane and its corresponding neighboring disc endpoint
intentional_overlap_allowlist.reason: A shared zero-volume surface is intentional.
intentional_overlap_allowlist.does_not_allow: Reversed gaps or positive-volume body/disc overlap

independent_method_references.use: Tensor and parallel-axis definitions for independent analytic controls.
Grid refinement principles; no CFD order or GCI bound is transferred to voxel anatomy.
Context-specific credibility distinction only. No FDA assessment, clearance or certification is claimed.
